$comment: The six facilities. slug = internal id (doctors.json, forms, footer, tests); path = URL segment under hospitals/ (the live site's URLs quoted in Website Content - Suhad/Our Hospitals, e.g. /ae/hospitals/cambridge-hospital-abu-dhabi/). Full name = brand + ' ' + city ('Al Mudeef Centre' spelling from the documents, one spelling site-wide). listTitle / listButton = the Our Hospitals list card ('Abu Dhabi Hospital' ... 'Al Mudeef Centre' + 'View Centre', from the Our Hospitals main page document, 5 Oct 2026). address + listPhoto as in Figma 101:6247. Detail pages (Figma 112:7721): phone (click-to-call, international format) and hours ({en, ar}) are NOT in Figma or the documents and wait for Pramod (empty = not shown). mapUrl = the live site's own 'Open in Google Maps' link of each hospital page (maps.app.goo.gl share links, saved live pages docs/cambridge-images-live/_pages/*/hospitals/*.html, 9 Oct 2026): the hospital pages' Google Maps button, and the Contact map card's directions link while a hospital has no position (Jeddah). Arabic names, list titles, addresses and 'View Centre' = the live site's Arabic Our Hospitals page and footer (WordPress export pages 19104 / 19153 / block 19169, 6 Oct 2026). location (bug 051, the ONE place for hospital positions: Contact Us map markers, directions links, hospital-page 'Open in Google Maps'): lat / lng = the hospital's exact position (required for a marker), placeId = its Google Place ID (optional, sharpens the directions link), source = where the value comes from. Five positions = the hospital's own Google place, checked 7 Oct 2026 (client approval pending, R051). Jeddah's position (bug 182, 16 Oct 2026) = the live site's own share link resolved to its Google place 'Cambridge Hospital Jeddah' (Al-Ruwais), the only hospital with a placeId so far; never fill a position with a guess or a Google text-search result. Bug 182 (16 Oct 2026): every Google Maps target (Contact map marker + directions, hospital page button) now comes from location first; mapUrl is only a fallback while a hospital has no position, and a hospital without a position gets no marker, no directions link and no button rather than a dead or wrong destination (Jeddah was in that state until its share link was resolved the same day).
